keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Tom Atcheson (Blackburn Rovers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Jayden Fevrier replaces Tom Atcheson because of an injury.
Goal! Burnley 1, Blackburn Rovers 0. Largie Ramazani (Burnley) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Kyle Walker.
Kyle Walker (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Burnley 1, Blackburn Rovers 1. Andri Gudjohnsen (Blackburn Rovers) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sean McLoughlin with a through ball following a set piece situation.
Oliver Sonne (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Burnley 2, Blackburn Rovers 1. Jaydon Banel (Burnley) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Igor Julio.
Josh Laurent (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Sean McLoughlin (Blackburn Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Jaydon Banel (Burnley).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Burnley. Marcus Edwards replaces Jaydon Banel because of an injury.
Gady Beyuku (Blackburn Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Ryoya Morishita replaces Jayden Fevrier.
Goal! Burnley 2, Blackburn Rovers 2. Todd Cantwell (Blackburn Rovers) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the high centre of the goal.
Substitution, Burnley. Hjalmar Ekdal replaces Igor Julio.
Substitution, Burnley. Jamie Vardy replaces Zeki Amdouni.
Substitution, Burnley. Aaron Ramsey replaces Reo Hatate.
Josh Cullen (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Hayden Carter (Blackburn Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Yuki Ohashi replaces Oladapo Afolayan.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Augustus Kargbo replaces Todd Cantwell.
